body:
Greptile Summary

 The PR repairs orphaned Redis v1 directory-index members during listing while preserving concurrently recreated entries and directories with child indexes. - Removes stale parent SET members when their value keys are missing. - Rechecks value and child-index keys before deciding whether to restore membership. - Adds Redis-backed tests for orphan removal, recreation, and live-child preservation.

Confidence Score: 3/5

 The PR is not yet safe to merge because concurrent updates can lose directory membership and stale child indexes can prevent cleanup from converging. The repair can return after observing an absent value and then race with UpdateEntry, which writes no parent membership, while treating any child-index key as live also perpetually restores directories whose indexed children have all expired. **Files Needing Attention:** weed/filer/redis/universal_redis_store.go

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | weed/filer/redis/universal_redis_store.go | Adds listing-time orphan repair, but the two previously reported concurrency and stale-child-index defects remain. | | weed/filer/redis/universal_redis_store_test.go | Adds integration coverage for intended repair behavior but does not cover the outstanding stale-only child index or UpdateEntry interleaving. |
